sentences.text:
National Insurance Co. Ltd vs Smt. Alokrani Das & Ors on 7
August, 2025
07.08.2025

Ct. No.33
Sl. No.69
cm Fmat 691 of 2018
 Can 1/2019 (Old No. Can 9264/2019)
 Can 2/2019 (Old No. Can 9265/2019)
 National Insurance Co. Ltd.
 Vs.
 Smt. Alokrani Das & Ors.
 Mr. Kanak Kiran Bandyopadhyay
 ... for the appellant/insurance co.
 Ms. Juin Dutta Chakraborty
 Ms. Arpita Kundu
 ... for the respondent Nos. 1 to 6/claimants
In Re: Can 1 of 2019 (Old No. Can 9264/2019) The learned advocates representing the
appellant/insurance company and respondent Nos. 1 to 6/claimants are present.
The application being CAN 1 of 2019 (Old No. CAN 9264/2019) under Section 5 of the limitation Act has been taken up for hearing.
From the record it reveals that there is a delay of 130 days.

Considering the averments made in Paragraph 4 to 9 of the CAN application being 1 of 2019 (Old No. CAN 9264/2019) and in view of the beneficial legislative intent the delay of 130 days in filing the instant case is condoned.
The application being CAN 1 of 2019 (Old No. CAN 9264/2019) is allowed.
The Department is directed to register the appeal.
Call for the lower court records.
In Re: CAN 2 of 2019 (Old No. CAN 9265/2019)

As per the order of this Court dated 22.07.2025 the Insurance Company had deposited the entire awarded compensation before the office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta vide OD Challan No. 656 (A) dated 06.08.2025.
Let the said challan be kept on record.

Accordingly, stay of the impugned judgment and order dated 16th September, 2017 passed by the Learned Judge, M.A.C. Tribunal cum Special Court, Chinsurah, Hooghly in M.A.C. Case No. 147 of 2015 under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act be stayed till the disposal of the instant appeal.

entities.text: M.A.C. Tribunal cum Special Court, Chinsurah, Hooghly

sentences.text: The application being CAN 2 of 2019 (Old No. CAN 9265/2019 is disposed of.
